$comment: Authority Surface manifest — frozen policy input for the K0 gate. See AUTHORITY-KERNEL.md §3. rawModules maps a raw authority source (module specifier or Bun API) to its effect class. kernelDeclaredPaths are the ONLY paths allowed to hold raw sources without a baseline grandfather entry; it is intentionally empty until M1 migrates the first effect class. enforcement:'audit' means new undeclared sources FAIL while grandfathered baseline entries remain recorded.
$packageRulesComment: forbiddenModules under pathPrefix fail REGARDLESS of baseline — grandfathering never rescues a forbidden class. Used by M1 to make agent-path process execution bypass-proof.
